notes: images_v3[] added by scripts/refacing/migrate-manifest-to-v3.mjs (PR-12 EXECUTION SPEC · non-destructive · categories[] and step_units[] byte-preserved). Every derived field marked with confidence 'inferred' or 'unknown' per PR-16 — never 'observed' without human tagger review. Style / mood / canonical_profile_ids / compatibility_group_ids fields await manual pass.

STEP-UNIT taxonomy (2026-08-12): the top-level `step_units` array holds isometric single-step product renders organized by riser_material family (metal · painted · wood · glass). Each entry declares `pattern` and `tread_species` for the right-rail + dynamic-footer browsing surface. Distinct from `categories` (below) which holds full-staircase hero-scene photos for the inspiration-browsing surface. Full taxonomy: memory `project_nex_refacing_step_unit_taxonomy_2026_08_12.md`.

Step-unit family dominance rule: when a step contains multiple materials (frame + inset, riser + tread), file it under the RISER's DOMINANT visual family. Painted frame + wood arch inset → painted. Wood frame + painted arch inset → wood. Brushed metal riser + wood tread → metal. Solid wood tread + solid wood riser → wood. Never place the same design under two families — pick the dominant one.

Every step-unit entry MUST declare: variant='step_unit' · riser_material (metal|painted|wood|glass) · pattern (flat|arched-wood-inset|arched-painted-inset|metal-plate|monolithic) · tread_species. Optional: materials[] (extended tag list). New pattern values require an amendment to project_nex_refacing_step_unit_taxonomy_2026_08_12.md.
To add a category · add a new object to the `categories` array with slug + label + optional description + images array.
To add an image to a category · drop the file into public/staircase-renovations/<slug>/ and add an object to `images`.
Image `src` is relative to the public root (no /public/ prefix). Example: /staircase-renovations/oak/hero-1.png
The `sort` field is optional; images render in array order if omitted.
Categories with 0 images still appear in the carousel; the viewer renders an honest empty state per category.

Content status (2026-08-11 · illustrative population): images are customer-facing design inspiration only · NOT customer BASE evidence · NOT authoritative staircase surveys · governance rules from BASE Analysis Protocol + UX Screens Illustrative memory apply.
Images may be referenced from multiple category entries (same src) when the design genuinely supports both categories · never duplicated where the fit isn't genuine.

The optional `materials` array on an image entry declares which wood-species the image genuinely represents in its TREADS/RISERS (the primary visual element the customer selects). Newel/handrail accents do NOT qualify. Species without any genuine library reference remain absent from the array. NEVER assign a species tag to an image that does not genuinely show that species — this metadata is what the material picker uses to guarantee 'tap Walnut → see a real walnut staircase' truthfulness.

Intake batch 2026-08-13: 58 whole-staircase hero photos ingested from ImageKit into public/staircase-renovations/intake-2026-08-13/ · fingerprint-deduped against existing whole_staircase entries · full per-component observations at data/staircase-renovations/intake/observations.json · ingest report at data/staircase-renovations/intake/ingest-report.md · component_role='whole_staircase' with material_composition[] covering tread/riser/baluster/newel/handrail/string_L/string_R/baserail/starting_step.
